answer: The MME Department offers Mechanical Engineering (MECH) and Mechatronics Engineering (MECA), each granting BS, BE and MS degrees. Its vision is to be recognized for the ability, agility and tenacity of its graduates in a changing workplace.

answer: The Mechanical Engineering program provides a solid education for a professional career or graduate study, instilling moral and professional responsibility, self-learning and leadership, mainly in Lebanon and the Middle East. source_quote: Upon successful completion of the BS/BE program in Mechanical Engineering,
answer: Mechanical Engineering graduates achieve the seven ABET-style outcomes: solving complex engineering problems, engineering design, communication, ethical responsibility, teamwork, experimentation and data analysis, and acquiring new knowledge.

source_quote: The Bachelor of Engineering (BE) program in Mechanical Engineering comprises 152
answer: The BE in Mechanical Engineering is 152 credits over eight regular and three summer semesters; the BS is 118 credits over six regular and three summer semesters. Both require a CGPA, major GPA and SLP grade of 70 or above.
BS in Mechanical Engineering (118 credits): General Education 27 (23%), College Requirements 24 (20%), Program Requirements 67 (57%); major 49 mandatory, non-major 63 mandatory + 6 elective.

BE in Mechanical Engineering (152 credits): General Education 30 (20%), College Requirements 27 (18%), Program Requirements 95 (62%: 80 mandatory + 15 elective); major 59 mandatory + 15 elective, non-major 69 mandatory + 9 elective.

Mechanical mandatory courses: CIVE 211, ELEC 320/320L, MECA 340, 341/341L, 440/440L, 541; MECH 200, 220, 223, 224, 320/320L, 321, 330, 334/334L, 335/335L, 400 (BS project; BE takes an elective instead), 421, 422, 423, 431/431L, 435 HVAC, 499 Co-op, 520, 521, 595A, 595B, and 15 credits of MECH 4xx/5xx technical electives.

BE Mechanical students take 15 credits of technical electives in two areas: Mechanical Design and Manufacturing (e.g., MECH 445, 470, 498, 522, 523, 524, 525, 527, 570, 571) and Energy and Thermo-fluid Systems (e.g., MECH 436, 437, 445, 448, 451, 453, 455, 461, 468, 471, 530, 541); electives from other programs need advisor and instructor approval.
